**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 2.1, ¶p0012), confidence 0.72.**

- **Issue:** The document contains no express "liquidated damages" clause, but § 2.1 imposes an unconditional USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights." Any unconsumed volume becomes a shortfall payment Customer owes for nothing received — functionally a Customer-payable penalty/minimum fee, contrary to the playbook's preferred position.
- **Direction check:** Confirmed the exposure runs against us. Vendor-side remedies in our favour (refunds under §§ 10.2, 19.4, 27.3; § 1.5 excluding service credits from Fees) are untouched, and § 7.1 already bars undisclosed minimum-use charges.
- **Internal conflict noted:** § 12.3 states Customer has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," which is irreconcilable with § 2.1.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** § 2.1 recast so volumes are non-binding forecasts and Customer bears no take-or-pay shortfall, liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination charge, preserving our reduction/non-renewal/termination rights. Fallback offered in the comment: a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.
